prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.positive_placeholder: Enter prompt (A1111 format), e.g.: 1girl, solo, long hair, looking at viewer, smile, white dress, outdoors, blue sky, masterpiece, best quality
prompt.positive_placeholder_natural: Describe the image in natural language, e.g.: A red fox standing on a mossy rock in a misty forest at dawn, backlit, cinematic composition, highly detailed
prompt.negative_placeholder: Enter negative prompt, e.g.: worst quality, low quality, blurry, bad anatomy, bad hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, watermark, text

tools.llm_assist_title: Generate or refine prompts with AI
tools.prompt_editor_title: Visual tag editor with autocomplete and tag library

prompt.video_ph: Describe how the scene moves: subject → action → camera → setting. e.g.: A girl turns and glances back, long hair flowing, camera slowly pushing in…
prompt.negative_video_ph: A recommended negative prompt is built in — leave empty to use the default
prompt.syntax_help_title: Model prompt and random syntax help

sdxl.title: SDXL (tag style)
sdxl.format: Use English tags or short phrases separated by commas. A few key elements may be emphasized with (tag:1.1).
sdxl.order: Quality/style → subject/count → appearance/clothing → pose/action → composition/camera → lighting/background.
sdxl.special: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, red dress, standing in a garden, soft sunlight, medium shot
sdxl.negative: Use the negative box for low quality, anatomy errors, text/watermarks and other exclusions; keep the same comma-tag format.

anima.title: Anima (Danbooru/Gelbooru tags)
anima.format: Use lowercase English tags or phrases separated by commas. Replace ordinary underscores with spaces; keep underscores in score_* tags.
anima.order: Quality/meta/year/safety → count → character → series → @artist → appearance, action, composition and setting.
anima.special: masterpiece, best quality, score_7, safe, 1girl, character, series, @artist, red dress, outdoors
anima.negative: Start from worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, artist name, blurry, jpeg artifacts, chromatic aberration, then tailor it to the scene.

krea2.title: Krea 2 (natural language)
krea2.format: Write a short natural-language paragraph (Chinese or English) with observable subjects, materials and setting; avoid Danbooru tag piles.
krea2.order: Subject → appearance/material → action or relationship → environment → lighting/composition → style.
krea2.special: A red ceramic teapot on a walnut table, morning window light from the left, close product photograph.
krea2.negative: Krea 2 Turbo does not use a negative prompt. Leave it empty and express exclusions as the desired positive result.

zimage.title: Z-Image (natural language)
zimage.format: Use complete Chinese or English sentences describing the subject, action, spatial relationships and visible text.
zimage.order: Subject/count → appearance and action → scene → composition/text content → lighting and style.
zimage.special: 雨夜的便利店门口，红色灯牌清晰写着“营业中”，广角街拍，湿漉地面反光。
zimage.negative: Leave empty. Rewrite exclusions as the desired positive result.

flux1.title: Flux 1 (natural language)
flux1.format: Use complete English sentences or a short paragraph describing relationships, materials and space; do not stack Danbooru tags.
flux1.order: Subject/relationship → appearance/material → action → environment → light/color → composition and style.
flux1.special: A red-haired woman reading beside a tall window, warm late-afternoon light, quiet library, medium shot, editorial photography.
flux1.negative: Leave empty. Rewrite exclusions as the desired positive result.

chroma.title: Chroma (natural language)
chroma.format: Use coherent English prose describing the subject, action, setting, lighting and style.
chroma.order: Subject → relationship/action → scene and objects → lighting/colors → camera and artistic style.
chroma.special: Blue glass bottles and sliced citrus on dark stone, soft side light, tactile editorial still life.
chroma.negative: Use short English phrases for unwanted elements or artifacts, such as blurry, malformed details, watermark.

flux2klein4b.title: Flux 2 Klein 4B (natural language)
flux2klein4b.format: Use a natural-language paragraph: state the subject and relationships first, then materials, space, light and composition; avoid tag piles.
flux2klein4b.order: Subject/relationship → action → environment/material → lighting/color → camera and style.
flux2klein4b.special: A compact silver robot repairs a bicycle in a bright workshop, precise hand placement, clean overhead light, wide shot.
flux2klein4b.negative: Leave empty. Describe the desired state with positive sentences.

flux2klein9b.title: Flux 2 Klein 9B (natural language)
flux2klein9b.format: Use a natural-language paragraph: state the subject and relationships first, then materials, space, light and composition; avoid tag piles.
flux2klein9b.order: Subject/relationship → action → environment/material → lighting/color → camera and style.
flux2klein9b.special: A compact silver robot repairs a bicycle in a bright workshop, precise hand placement, clean overhead light, wide shot.
flux2klein9b.negative: Leave empty. Describe the desired state with positive sentences.

flux2dev.title: Flux 2 Dev (natural language)
flux2dev.format: Write a natural-language English paragraph describing subject, spatial relationships, materials and mood; do not replace sentences with tag piles.
flux2dev.order: Subject/relationship → action → environmental detail → lighting/color → composition and style.
flux2dev.special: A cyclist crosses a rain-soaked night market, red signs reflected on the road, camera at street level, documentary photograph.
flux2dev.negative: Leave empty. Describe the desired state with positive sentences.

pony.title: Pony (score tags)
pony.format: Use comma-separated tags; start with the full score prefix score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up, score_6_up, and do not mix in masterpiece.
pony.order: Score/source → count and character → appearance/clothing → pose/action → composition → scene and lighting.
pony.special: score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up, score_6_up, source_anime, rating_safe, 1girl, red dress, looking at viewer
pony.negative: You may start with score_5, score_4, score_3, score_2, score_1, followed by exclusions such as bad anatomy/hands and watermark.

illustrious.title: Illustrious (prose / tag hybrid)
illustrious.format: Official guidance supports precise natural language, Danbooru tags, or a hybrid; quality prefixes are optional rather than mandatory.
illustrious.order: Quality/aesthetic → subject and character → appearance/clothing → pose/action → composition/camera → background and light.
illustrious.special: 1girl, red dress, holding an umbrella, rain, city street. She stands beneath a blue shop awning while traffic passes behind her.
illustrious.negative: Common exclusions include low quality, bad anatomy/hands, extra digits, watermark, signature and artist name; remove irrelevant items.

noobai.title: NoobAI (tag style)
noobai.format: Use comma-separated English tags; the common exact prefix is masterpiece, best quality, newest, absurdres, highres, safe.
noobai.order: 1girl/1boy → character → series → artists → special → general → other (omit details that are not visible).
noobai.special: masterpiece, best quality, newest, absurdres, highres, safe, 1girl, character, series, artist:name, red dress, outdoors
noobai.negative: The official base list includes nsfw, worst quality, old, early, low quality, lowres, signature, username, logo, bad hands, mutated hands, mammal, anthro, furry, ambiguous form, feral, semi-anthro; remove terms that conflict with the user's goal.

wan22_i2v.title: Wan 2.2 I2V (image to video)
wan22_i2v.format: Write a short natural-language English paragraph; the first frame already defines appearance, so focus on feasible motion, timing and camera.
wan22_i2v.order: First-frame retention → subject motion/speed → camera movement → environment and lighting change.
wan22_i2v.special: She slowly turns toward the window and smiles; her hair moves in a light breeze as the camera gently pushes in.
wan22_i2v.negative: Standard mode can use short exclusions; in Fast mode (CFG=1) negative prompts have no effect, so leave it empty.

wan22_t2v.title: Wan 2.2 T2V (text to video)
wan22_t2v.format: Write a natural-language English paragraph that introduces subject appearance and setting, then describes one continuous action; do not stack tags.
wan22_t2v.order: Subject/appearance → continuous action/rhythm → camera movement → environment, lighting and mood.
wan22_t2v.special: A woman walks through a rainy street and looks back; the camera tracks forward while neon reflections ripple across the road.
wan22_t2v.negative: Standard mode can use short exclusions; in Fast mode (CFG=1) negative prompts have no effect, so leave it empty.

wan22_5b.title: Wan 2.2 5B (T2V / I2V)
wan22_5b.format: Use natural language: T2V writes the complete subject and setting; I2V follows the first frame and mainly writes motion and camera.
wan22_5b.order: Subject/first-frame retention → action and rhythm → camera → environment and lighting change.
wan22_5b.special: T2V: A paper boat drifts downstream as the camera follows. I2V: The boat rocks gently while the camera pans left.
wan22_5b.negative: Use short English phrases for jitter, flicker, deformation, text and watermarks.

minimax_h3.title: MiniMax H3 (T2VA / I2VA)
minimax_h3.format: Use natural English with fixed fields in order: integrated_multimodal_description → overall_soundscape → non_diegetic_music; for I2V/FL2V put keyframe alignment on the first line.
minimax_h3.order: Put action, camera, dialogue and diegetic sound in integrated_multimodal_description → summarize ambient/action sounds in overall_soundscape → write audience-only music in non_diegetic_music.
minimax_h3.negative: CFG-distilled H3 does not use a negative prompt; leave it empty instead of adding a generic quality list.

minimax_h3_ref.title: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA (reference video)
minimax_h3_ref.format: Use natural English with six fixed sections: subject_definitions → summary → retention_analysis → detailed_description → overall_soundscape → non_diegetic_music.
minimax_h3_ref.order: Define subjects and reference bindings first, then retention/replacement rules and timed motion/camera, ending with audio and music.
minimax_h3_ref.special:
subject_definitions: <Subject 1> ...
summary: [reference generation] ...
retention_analysis: <Subject 1>: fully_preserved - ...
detailed_description: [Shot 1] ...
minimax_h3_ref.negative: Ref2VA has no negative prompt; put dialogue/SFX/ambient audio in overall_soundscape and music or N/A in non_diegetic_music.

help.comma_desc: Describe each element with a phrase, separated by commas
help.weight_up_desc: Increase influence on generation, value > 1.0 means stronger
help.weight_down_desc: Value < 1.0 weakens influence, can also fine-tune negative prompts
help.embedding_desc: Use installed Embedding vectors (browse via toolbar 'Insert Embedding')
help.quality_desc: Positive: include masterpiece, best quality. Negative: include worst quality, low quality
help.natural_sentence_desc: Describe the image in complete natural language; the model understands semantics — no tag stacking needed
help.natural_order_desc: Suggested order: subject → action/pose → scene → lighting & mood → style
help.natural_detail_desc: Concrete nouns and adjectives beat abstract words; describe "what it looks like" rather than listing "what is there"
help.natural_no_weight_desc: (word:1.4) weighting and embedding syntax are ineffective or unreliable for these models; emphasize with plain words (e.g. highly detailed)
help.random_pick_desc: → red hair / green hair / blue hair
help.random_multi_desc: → cat, dog / cat, bird / dog, bird
help.wildcard_multi_desc: → Picks 2 distinct values from hair_color.txt; \{2-3$$__…__\} picks 2–3.
help.nesting_desc: → a big cat / a small cat / a red ball / a blue ball

background.iterations_help: Stops automatically after this many rounds; ∞ runs until you stop it

basic.title: Basic Settings
basic.unet_seg_help: Wan 2.2 14B splits generation into two stages: the high-noise weight lays down the composition, the low-noise weight adds detail. Pick both files — they must be the two halves of the same model.

advanced.title: Advanced Settings
advanced.sampler_help: Controls the image generation algorithm. euler is fast and stable, dpmpp_2m produces higher quality but is slightly slower. Use default if unsure
advanced.scheduler_help: Controls the magnitude of change at each sampling step. normal is most versatile, karras may produce finer details. Use default if unsure
advanced.seed_help: Same seed + same parameters = same image. Click the dice icon to toggle random/fixed mode
advanced.batch_help: Number of images generated per run. Random prompts and random seeds use the same result across multiple images
advanced.prefix_help: Save path and filename for generated images. Default uses date folders and timestamps to ensure unique filenames. Cloud sync may overwrite same-named files, keeping timestamps is recommended
advanced.clip_skip_help: Stops CLIP encoding at the Nth-to-last layer. Pony and Illustrious require 2 to produce correct results; SDXL base uses 1
advanced.vae_override_help: Override the checkpoint's built-in VAE with an external VAE file. Some anime checkpoints (e.g. Pony) recommend an external sdxl_vae for better color reproduction
advanced.clip_filter_help: Official components for this architecture are listed first (★), compatible variants next (☆). Other encoders are selectable but may produce garbage.
advanced.clip_incompatible: Not a {arch} text encoder — generation may fail
advanced.vae_incompatible: Not a {arch} VAE — generation may fail

preview.offline_desc: Generate requires ComfyUI service to work

video.start_frame_not_image: A video cannot be used as a start frame — please pick an image
video.speed_help: Fast: 4 steps, negative prompt has no effect. Standard: 20 steps, finer detail, about 5x the time of Fast.
video.res_help: When the selected size has a different aspect ratio from the start frame, the start frame is center-cropped to fit.
video.refs_help_syntax_a: Reference assets in the prompt as <Picture 1>, <Video 1>, <Audio 1>; numbers are per-type order, matching the tile badges on the left
video.refs_help_syntax_b: Example: The character's appearance follows <Picture 1>, with the camera move of <Video 1>, singing in the style of <Audio 1>
video.refs_help_usage_a: Assign each reference an explicit job (character look / scene / style / camera / motion / voice timbre / music style…)
video.refs_help_usage_b: Video references drive motion, camera and editing rhythm; audio references drive timbre, melody, rhythm or music style
video.refs_help_limits_a: Images ≤ 9; videos ≤ 3 clips (2–15 s each, ≤ 15 s total); audio ≤ 3 clips (2–15 s each, ≤ 15 s total)
video.refs_help_limits_b: Mixed inputs ≤ 12 files in total; audio cannot be the sole reference — pair it with an image or video
video.refs_help_formats_a: Video: H.264 / H.265 (MP4), ≤ 50 MB per file
video.refs_help_formats_b: Audio: WAV / MP3, ≤ 15 MB per file; Images: JPG / PNG / WEBP…, ≤ 20 MB per file

lora.empty_warn: Please add LoRA first before enabling

i2i.denoise_help: Controls similarity to the original image. Lower values stay closer to the original, higher values produce more changes. 0.3=minor, 0.5=moderate, 0.7=major repaint
i2i.select_ref: Please select a reference image first
i2i.no_image_for_mask: Please select a reference image first
i2i.grow_mask_by_help: Auto-expand mask edges by this many pixels for smoother transitions between repainted and original areas. Recommended: 4-8

mask_editor.title: Mask Editor
mask_editor.help: Use brush to mark areas for regeneration (red overlay), unmarked areas will be preserved

controlnet.strength_help_pose: Controls how strictly the pose constraint is applied. Higher values follow the skeleton map more strictly
controlnet.strength_help_canny: Controls how strictly the edge constraint is applied. Higher values follow the edge map more strictly
controlnet.strength_help_depth: Controls how strictly the depth constraint is applied. Higher values follow the depth map more strictly
controlnet.start_help: Sampling step ratio where ControlNet starts (0.0 = from beginning)
controlnet.end_help: Sampling step ratio where ControlNet stops (1.0 = until end)
controlnet.need_model: Please install a ControlNet model first
controlnet.need_ref: Please upload a reference image first
controlnet.low_threshold_help: Lower edge detection threshold. Pixels below this value won't be considered edges. Lower values detect more detail, higher values reduce noise
controlnet.high_threshold_help: Upper edge detection threshold. Pixels above this value are confirmed as edges. A larger gap between thresholds yields fewer edges
controlnet.detect_resolution_help: Preprocessor input resolution. Higher values capture more detail but run slower
controlnet.preprocess_blocked: Please wait for the current task to finish

upscale.need_model: Please install an upscale model first
upscale.need_download: This feature requires upscale model download
upscale.engine_help: AuraSR: GAN super-resolution — fast with sharp, dimensional edges. SeedVR2: diffusion-based restoration — accurate texture reconstruction and clean flat areas, at higher VRAM and time cost
upscale.svr_color_help: Color matching algorithm applied after upscaling. LAB is generally good, Wavelet preserves texture detail better
upscale.svr_tiled_vae_help: Recommended for 3x/4x large images — decodes VAE in tiles to prevent out of memory
upscale.svr_input_noise_help: 0 = faithful to original; higher values allow more creative detail
upscale.svr_latent_noise_help: 0 = faithful to original; higher values allow more creative detail
upscale.method_help: Overlap checkerboard eliminates tile seams, suitable for most scenes; standard mode is fastest but may show seams
upscale.tile_size_help: Number of tiles processed at once. Higher values are faster but use more VRAM; reduce if running out of memory
upscale.downscale_method_help: Interpolation algorithm used when scaling from 4x to target size at 2x/3x. Not used at 4x

hires.denoise_help: Controls how much the second pass modifies the image. Lower values stay closer to original, higher values add more detail but may deviate from composition. Recommended 0.3-0.5
hires.steps_help: Sampling steps for the second pass. More steps produce finer details but take longer. Usually 15-25 is sufficient

face.denoise_help: Lower values preserve facial structure and only refine details; higher values repaint more but may change identity. Images without detected faces pass through unchanged; all detected faces are refined.
face.prompt_placeholder: Leave empty to inherit the main prompt. Describe the face only: expression / skin / makeup…
face.prompt_help: Empty = inherit the main prompt. When set, it applies only to the face crop, preventing scene/outfit words from painting artifacts on the face. The negative prompt always follows the main settings.
face.mask_mode_help: Shape of the paste-back mask. Box: feathered rectangle from the detection box; SAM contour: facial-feature segmentation for a cleaner blend. Unavailable until the SAM weight is downloaded from this module’s setup page
face.cfg_help: Default 7. Set to 1 for distilled models such as Krea2 / Z-Image / Flux.
face.guide_size_help: Target short-edge resolution of the upscaled face crop. Larger = more detail, slower.
face.crop_factor_help: How much context around the face box is included, avoiding seams at the paste-back border.
face.bbox_threshold_help: Lower = detect more faces (may include false positives); higher = stricter.
face.feather_help: Blend width when pasting the refined face back, preventing visible seams.
face.need_model: Please install the face detection model first
face.need_download: This feature requires face model download

interrogate.title: Interrogate Settings
interrogate.general_threshold_help: Confidence threshold for general tags. Lower values detect more tags but may be inaccurate, higher values are more precise but may miss some
interrogate.character_threshold_help: Confidence threshold for character tags. Higher threshold recommended for character recognition to reduce false positives
interrogate.replace_underscore_help: Replace underscores in tags with spaces, making output more suitable for prompts
interrogate.exclude_tags_help: Specify tags to exclude. Commonly used to filter background, rating, and other irrelevant tags
interrogate.empty_result: Interrogation complete but no tags found
interrogate.need_model: This feature requires downloading a tagger model
